name: Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant
scope: Whole approximate 2021 Unit 1 power block: remaining postexplosion reactor concrete body and retained operating deck, separately positioned whole 14-corner turbine building and intrinsic shared 1/2 exhaust stack shortened and capped at 59 m. Three independently located structures are kept as separate closed/open meshes inside one bounded unit asset; no filled compound polygon, intact 1971 reactor roof or 120 m later stack. Other units, tanks, unrelated forecourt buildings and plant-wide context remain separate.

references.caption: Tokyo Electric Power Co., Fukushima Nuclear Power Station on the Pacific Ocean, 160 miles North of Tokyo, 1.2 square mile site. Japan.

originalReview.notes: Reuse of the existing accepted, personally inspected two original DOE aerial references for the established Unit 1 turbine identity/relative stack location and broad historic finish only. These 1971 images do not prove 2021 damage, stack cut, exact later facades or whole-site appearance. New postdamage/cut geometry comes from original numerical/factual text; continuity and finish estimates are explicit.

review.method: Existing cleared Qualla DOE originals with limited historical use; original numerical and damage/cut text for new 2021 geometry.
review.notes: Qualla first: 25 published image families / zero conflicts. Reuse only the two already cleared DOE circa-1971 originals for limited established relative stack location and broad historic turbine/stack finish. They do not establish a complete 2021 plant appearance. Actual 2012 operator damage/floor levels, original NRC dimensions, 2011 operator turbine dimensions, 2020 operator 59 m cut/cap facts and original 2019 Overture/OSM coordinates control the new representation. All operator/regulator report photos/figures/plans are unused. Exact later damage/repairs, turbine roof subdivisions, paint/brace details, 2021 continuity and vertical ground tie remain explicit estimates. Existing accepted historical models and QA remain unchanged.
